info.name: PickleCoach API (By Type)
info.description:
Endpoints grouped by resource/type. Use for finding a specific endpoint, debugging, and sharing with frontend. For flow-based testing use PickleCoach API (By Flow).

**Dev logins** (run `npm run seed:test-flows` in backend/ first):
- Admin: admin.testflow@picklecoach.example.org / Test1234!Ab
- Coach: coach.testflow@picklecoach.example.org / Test1234!Ab
- Student: student.testflow@picklecoach.example.org / Test1234!Ab

Register uses a unique email per send (pre-request script); password Test1234!Ab.

request.description: Roles: Any (no auth). Check if the server and database are running.

PUT /auth/me/role — add one capability per request (`student` or `coach`). Additive only (does not remove roles). Admins get 403; governance may block. Body: `{ "role": "student" | "coach" }`. Response may include a new JWT — save it (test script sets auth_token).
Invalidate current and all other tokens for this user (increments token_version). Client should discard the token after calling.

Soft delete the current user's account (deleted_at, is_active false; coach profile soft-deleted). If the user has an admin role in user_roles, allowed only when at least one other live admin remains (409 last_admin_required otherwise). Same invariant as DELETE /api/users/:id.

item.name: Bookings
item.description: Authorize-first: POST /booking-intents → client Stripe authorization → POST /bookings/confirm (student). Coach: PUT .../accept and PUT .../decline. Extended routes: complete, student-no-show, cancel. **Schedule changes:** cancel + book again (no reschedule API). Legacy POST /bookings returns 410.

request.description: POST /booking-intents. Student + verified email. **Required:** `lesson_id`, `scheduled_at`, `court_location_id` (one of coach's courts). Duration/price come from the lesson — do **not** send `duration_minutes` or `player_ids` (400). Creates manual-capture Stripe PaymentIntent; no booking row yet. Response: **`amount`** = USD dollars (e.g. 54), **`amount_cents`** = Stripe units (e.g. 5400), **`currency`**: `usd`. Then authorize with Stripe and POST /bookings/confirm.

request.description: Roles: Admin. Superset body template; trim fields per dispute type. Attendance: required `outcome`; `rejected` uses contradicting outcome; `financial_action` must match outcome (coach_no_show → refund path, student_no_show → no_change). Behavior: omit `outcome`. `penalize_role` behavior only. `refund_amount` for `refund_student_partial`. Response: `data.dispute` carries the resolution on the row itself — `decision`, `outcome` (attendance only, otherwise null), and `refund_amount` (US dollar decimal string; populated only for partial refunds, null for full refunds and `no_change`). For full refunds the executed amount is filled on the linked `payment_actions` row (by `dispute_id`) once the worker runs. See `backend/API_ENDPOINTS.md`.

item.description: Reference-only folder. Stripe (and other signed webhooks) cannot be tested from Postman with a hand-crafted body because the server verifies `Stripe-Signature` against the raw request bytes using `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. Use `stripe listen` or the Stripe Dashboard to trigger events.

request.description:
**DO NOT RUN MANUALLY.**

Stripe calls this endpoint directly. It verifies the `Stripe-Signature` header using `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, so a hand-crafted body in Postman will return **400 Webhook Error: No signatures found matching the expected signature**.

### How to actually test it
1. Install the Stripe CLI.
2. Run: `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:4000/api/webhooks/stripe`
3. Copy the printed `whsec_...` into `.env.development` as `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, then restart the backend.
4. Trigger events, e.g.:
   - `stripe trigger payment_intent.succeeded`
   - `stripe trigger charge.refunded`
   - `stripe trigger charge.dispute.created`
5. Or, in the Stripe Dashboard, use **Developers → Events → Resend** on a real event.

Handled event types (see `backend/controllers/webhookController.js`):
- payment_intent.succeeded / payment_failed / canceled
- charge.refunded
- charge.dispute.created / updated / closed
- transfer.created / transfer.paid

Success response: `{ "received": true }` (or `{ "received": true, "duplicate": true }`).

Roles: System (Stripe webhook; no user auth; uses Stripe-Signature verification).

exec: throw new Error("This webhook is documentation only. Use `stripe listen` or Dashboard resend. See request description.");
